au.csiro.JamesGunning.sulib
Class SuWriter

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--au.csiro.JamesGunning.sulib.SuWriter
public class SuWriter
extends java.lang.Object

Basic class to put seismic traces in su format, rather like the fputtr.c suite of functions in SeismicUnix. Given a SuSegyFormat object to hold the trace, and an opened RandomAccessFile (for disk files) or FileOutputStream (for stdin), traces are written from the SuSegyFormat by the fputtr(RandomAccessFile fp, SuSegyFormat tr) or fputtr(FileOutputStream fp, SuSegyFormat tr) calls. An example usage fragment is

FileInputStream stdin;
FileOutputStream stdout;
SuReader sureader = new SuReader();
SuWriter suwriter = new SuWriter();
SuSegyFormat tr = new SuSegyFormat();
// get input stream (stdin)
stdin = (FileInputStream) new FileInputStream(FileDescriptor.in);
// get input stream (stdout)
stdout = (FileOutputStream) new FileOutputStream(FileDescriptor.out);
while (sureader.fgettr(stdin,tr) != 0) // get traces
{
// do stuff with traces here....
suwriter.fputtr((FileOutputStream)stdout,tr);
}
...
